# POST /api/auth/signin/email/confirmation/otp

Confirm email signin with a verification code.

Requires an existing active user and an active owner/admin organization membership.
Records a new session. Cookie delivery (default) requires an allowed Origin, sets both
HttpOnly cookies and returns an empty JSON object. Explicit delivery token returns
accessToken and refreshToken in JSON without setting cookies. Delivery is not a JWT claim.

## Authentication

Public endpoint. No user access credential is required.

## Parameters

| Name | Location | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Origin | header | false | Required for cookie delivery; must match the configured browser origin |

```json
  "description": "Required for cookie delivery; must match the configured browser origin",

  "name": "Origin",
  "required": false,
  "schema": {
    "type": [
      "string",
      "null"
    ]
  }
}
```

## Request body

Required: **true**.

Content type: `application/json`.

Email challenge, verification code, and credential delivery for an existing user.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| code | string | true | Six ASCII digits received by email; surrounding whitespace is trimmed. Valid for ten minutes. |
| delivery | string | false | How signup/signin confirmation delivers credentials. Never stored in JWT claims. |
| token | string | true | Encrypted challenge returned by the email code request. |

<details>
<summary>JSON schema</summary>

```json
{
  "description": "Email challenge, verification code, and credential delivery for an existing user.",
  "properties": {
    "code": {
      "description": "Six ASCII digits received by email; surrounding whitespace is trimmed. Valid for ten minutes.",
      "example": "123456",
      "maxLength": 6,
      "minLength": 6,
      "pattern": "^[0-9]{6}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "delivery": {
      "description": "How signup/signin confirmation delivers credentials. Never stored in JWT claims.",
      "enum": [
        "cookie",
        "token"
      ],
      "type": "string"
    },
    "token": {
      "description": "Encrypted challenge returned by the email code request.",
      "example": "example-email-challenge",
      "maxLength": 16384,
      "minLength": 1,
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "token",
    "code"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

</details>

Example (synthetic values):


### Example request

```bash
curl --request POST \
  'https://compallm.example/api/auth/signin/email/confirmation/otp' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
  "code": "123456",
  "delivery": "token",
  "token": "example-email-challenge"
}'
```

Replace URL parameters and supply any required query values and authentication described above.

## Responses

### 200

Signed in; cookie mode returns {} and sets both cookies; token mode returns both credentials

Content type: `application/json`.

Cookie delivery returns an empty object. Token delivery returns both credentials.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| accessToken | ["string","null"] | false | Access JWT, present only when delivery is token. |
| refreshToken | ["string","null"] | false | Refresh JWT, present only when delivery is token. |

<details>
<summary>JSON schema</summary>

```json

  "description": "Cookie delivery returns an empty object. Token delivery returns both credentials.",
  "properties": {
    "accessToken": {
      "description": "Access JWT, present only when delivery is token.",
```
